text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin suffers a frustrating loss<n>at the Arima
Kinen, but her running<n>captivates her family and
friends,<n>who praise her sheer determination.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just Ines's fans who<n>are moved by
the sight of her chasing<n>her dreams. Oguri
Cap—who was<n>rumored to be retiring—is also
inspired<n>to hope again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines's running isn't a selfish act at<n>all—it's the
very embodiment of<n>everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that it's okay for her to run<n>as much as
she wants, and to enjoy<n>it too, Ines wells up. It's
not long<n>before her cheeks are glistening with<n>warm
tears.
